Solve the following multiple-choice mathematics problem. You may reason before answering. End your final response with exactly "ANSWER: X", where X is one of A, B, C, D, E. Select one option.

three walls have wallpaper covering a combined area of 300 square meters . by overlapping the wallpaper to cover a wall with an area of 180 square meters , the area that is covered by exactly two layers of wallpaper is 34 square meters . what is the area that is covered with three layers of wallpaper ?

A. 43 square meters
B. 36 square meters
C. 42 square meters
D. 83.3 square meters
E. 120 square meters

message.reasoning_content: Total 300, wall 180, overlap = 300−180=120. Regions: x = exactly two, y = exactly three, x+2y=120, x=34 → y=43. A.
